title: Section screen: an acid slab and a white slab cut at 49 degrees with a stripe band between, the title block, a picture card with caption, a 'more' capsule and a carousel control
use: A full section of a game site (news, media, archive) at 16:9: one picture with its caption and a carousel. control=track gives a capsule track with three thumbs; control=dots gives dots.

side.note: title edge; right mirrors the slabs

ghost.note: ghost letters on the stripe band

headline.default: 1.3 版本「霜降夜频」更新维护预告

relations: Acid slab corner at 0.39-0.41 W, radius 52; white slab corner one stripe band (196 units) to its right; both cuts at 49 degrees (below 0.39 the number runs off the acid onto the stripes).
Title block at x 290 (or ending 290 from the right), top at 338; picture card 800 x 400 in the white slab, caption under it.
Acid only on the slab, the tag, the current thumb or dot.
decoration: Stripe band, film strip, ghost letters, thumbs, arrows, dots: drawn.
